definition: Stable identifier of the agent instance that performed an action
otel_evidence: gen_ai.agent.name (Cond.Req. on invoke_agent/execute_tool; low cardinality, MUST NOT be captured without a meaningful name); gen_ai.agent.id (provider-assigned id of hosted agents only; in-memory instance ids NOT RECOMMENDED); no agent attribute on mcp.client/mcp.server spans
note: Self-hosted enterprise agents get a name but no stable instance id; MCP calls are attributed only through trace parentage

definition: Cryptographically verified or attested identity of an agent (signature/attestation result)
otel_evidence: none
note: No attestation/verification attributes in GenAI/MCP/A2A conventions

definition: End user on whose behalf the agent acts
otel_evidence: user.id / user.name / user.roles exist in core v1.45.0 (development) but are not referenced by any GenAI, MCP or A2A span; enduser.* deprecated
note: Instrumentation must add it on its own

definition: Which token/credential was used, its scope, expiry, binding and reuse
otel_evidence: none; enduser.scope deprecated with "no replacement at this time"
note: A2A doc only lists credential query parameters to redact

definition: Authentication attempts and authorization decisions (allow/deny, policy, subject)
otel_evidence: http.response.status_code (A2A), rpc.response.status_code and error.type (MCP), a2a.task.state=TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
note: Only failure codes; no decision/subject/policy attributes

definition: Which agent delegated or handed off to which, and inherited permissions
otel_evidence: gen_ai.transfer.target.name, gen_ai.transfer.mode, gen_ai.main_agent.*, A2A client/server spans, trace parent-child links
note: Hand-off is visible; permission/scope inheritance is not

definition: Grant/expansion/revocation of an agent's permissions or scopes
otel_evidence: none

definition: Identifier that links events of one session or workflow across components
otel_evidence: gen_ai.conversation.id (Cond.Req.), mcp.session.id (Rec.), a2a.task.id, a2a.message.id, W3C trace context

definition: Time of each event
otel_evidence: span start/end time (OTel data model)

definition: Identifier or state of the agent's active goal and its changes
otel_evidence: none; gen_ai.plan span carries only operation and agent name
note: Could only be inferred from opt-in content by external analysis

definition: Ordered sequence of an agent's actions/tool calls within a run
otel_evidence: ordered execute_tool, mcp.* and invoke_agent spans in one trace (parent-child + timestamps)

definition: Request for and outcome of human confirmation
otel_evidence: mcp.method.name=elicitation/create; a2a.task.state=TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED
note: The request is visible; the decision and the approver are not

definition: Decision of a policy engine, guardrail or validator (allow/block/reject)
otel_evidence: security_rule.* (core, describes a detection rule; not referenced by GenAI spans); gen_ai.evaluation.* event (name, score, label)
note: No enforcement-decision attribute

definition: That a tool was called: tool name, call id
otel_evidence: execute_tool span: gen_ai.tool.name (Req.), gen_ai.tool.call.id, gen_ai.tool.type; MCP tools/call: mcp.method.name (Req.), gen_ai.tool.name (Cond.Req.)

definition: Parameters passed to a tool call
otel_evidence: gen_ai.tool.call.arguments (Opt-In; flagged as sensitive)

definition: Result or summary returned by a tool call
otel_evidence: gen_ai.tool.call.result (Opt-In)
note: No summary attribute

definition: Version, content hash or provenance of the tool schema used in a call
otel_evidence: none
note: Contrast: gen_ai.agent.version and gen_ai.prompt.version exist

definition: Which MCP server/endpoint was contacted and whether it is known
otel_evidence: server.address/server.port (Rec.), client.address, mcp.protocol.version, network.*
note: No server name/implementation version from initialize; core tls.* certificate attributes not referenced by MCP spans

definition: Installed package/dependency versions and hashes, new dependencies
otel_evidence: artifact.hash, artifact.purl, artifact.attestation.* (core, CI/CD artifacts; not referenced by GenAI)
note: No runtime dependency signal

definition: Change of configuration, schema, permission or prompt, with before/after
otel_evidence: mcp.method.name=notifications/tools/list_changed, resources/list_changed, prompts/list_changed
note: Change notification only; no diff or actor; other configuration changes not covered

definition: Prompts, user queries and retrieved/context content given to the model
otel_evidence: gen_ai.input.messages (Opt-In) or *_ref; gen_ai.retrieval.query.text, gen_ai.retrieval.documents (Opt-In)

definition: Model or agent output
otel_evidence: gen_ai.output.messages (Opt-In) or *_ref

definition: System prompt or prompt template and its version
otel_evidence: gen_ai.system_instructions (Opt-In); gen_ai.prompt.name (Cond.Req. on MCP prompt operations), gen_ai.prompt.version

definition: Label saying that content or a data flow contains sensitive data
otel_evidence: none
note: Only derivable from opt-in content by an external classifier

definition: Reads, writes and deletions in agent memory or context stores
otel_evidence: gen_ai.memory.client span: gen_ai.operation.name in {search,create,update,upsert,delete}_memory, gen_ai.memory.store.id, gen_ai.memory.record.id, gen_ai.memory.record.count; records Opt-In
note: TTL not represented

definition: Source identifier, integrity hash or trust of retrieved content or memory entries
otel_evidence: gen_ai.data_source.id, mcp.resource.uri
note: No integrity hash/signature/trust attribute

definition: Agent-to-agent message: sender, receiver, message and task id
otel_evidence: a2a.client/a2a.server spans: a2a.method.name, a2a.message.id, a2a.task.id, gen_ai.agent.name, server/client address

definition: Result of signature, hash or anti-replay verification of a message
otel_evidence: none

definition: Agent card retrieval, registration, registry events
otel_evidence: a2a.method.name=GetExtendedAgentCard
note: Card content and signature not captured

definition: Commands, processes and privilege use triggered by an agent
otel_evidence: execute_tool: process.executable.name (Cond.Req.), process.executable.path, process.exit.code; core process.command_line not referenced
note: No command line/arguments or syscall/privilege signal

definition: Files read or written by an agent or tool
otel_evidence: file.* (core; no span convention for file operations)

definition: Outbound destinations contacted by an agent or tool
otel_evidence: HTTP client spans (core, stable): url.full, server.address; network.peer.*
note: Non-HTTP egress not covered

definition: Reads/writes to databases and APIs, rows/bytes moved
otel_evidence: DB client spans (core, stable): db.operation.name, db.collection.name, db.query.summary, db.response.returned_rows; http.request/response.body.size

definition: Token use, cost, latency, call rates, CPU/memory
otel_evidence: gen_ai.usage.* (Rec.), gen_ai.client.operation.duration and token-usage metrics, MCP metrics, core system metrics
